name: Ashanti
notes: Murder Inc.'s hook singer turned star, on Irv Gotti and 7 Aurelius's loop-soul: an 80s R&B sample flipped under a soft topline, 2002–2005. The research gives "74–95 straight (backbeat 2&4)" with nine sourced tempos, so the mode is 89 — the tempo of the sourced record — and `halfTime` is false. Three drum deltas from "the sampled source's drums are replaced by a hard modern kit": "kick on 1 and the 16th before 3" moves the secondary anchor to `2a`; "snare/clap flat on 2&4" is a clap stack over a velocity-tier spread whose accent (112–127) sits far above its main (76–90), which is what replacing a loop's drums with a hard kit sounds like; "16th hats low" is a continuous lane at 0.24 fill density with the main velocity floor at 0.36. "A snare-roll pickup" is the `snareRollLadder` and a 16th roll block. Harmony is the sourced progression and the research states the habit as a rule: "**two-chord vamps** are the house habit — 'Foolish' is `IV maj7 – V` (Fmaj7–G) in C major for the entire record. Loop length 2 bars." So `IV–V` is the top family, C major is the top key against a minor-leaning lane, `maxChords` is 2 and the seventh share is 0.54. "Melody sits inside a 6th with almost no melisma, so the sample supplies all the motion" is a fourteen-semitone melody register, a 0.88 step share and a near-zero octave jump — the narrowest topline in this section. The low end is "sampled bass from the flipped source plus a sub-kick doubling; no independent 808 line", so no `bass808` block. ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are the velocity tiers, all density numbers and `swing.amount` 0.56. ⚠ `session.keys` is part-sourced: the entry names `C`, and the remaining values `F`, `Am`, `G`, together with all 4 weights, are INFERRED rather than read from the entry. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 938/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor), and every other lever this gate has was already clean here** — no empty-bar bias, no one-bar phrase length, and no lead allowed to thin below two notes a bar. What was left was the style pool: `generators::counter` can play five answer shapes and this block asked for 2. `octave_echo` is added at weight 2 because the entry already names it — "Thin, breathy, close-mic’d alto doubled many times; melody sits inside a 6th with almost no melisma, so the sample supplies all the motion" — and a lead doubled many times is a transposed copy of the lead, which is `octave_echo`; with the melody pinned inside a 6th the doubling is the only motion the entry gives this layer. ⚠ The weight is INFERRED; the layer it weights is not.
